description: This file declares utility functions and data structures for handling sets of strings and integers, as well as key-value pairs stored in a ds_tree data structure. It provides functions for creating, freeing, and comparing these structures, specifically tailored for OVSDB (Open vSwitch Database) utilities.

methods.name: str_tree_cmp
methods.description: Comparison routine for string pair trees, compares two generic pointers.

methods.name: schema2str_set
methods.description: Converts a static array of strings into a dynamically allocated string set.

methods.name: free_str_set
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a string set.

methods.name: schema2tree
methods.description: Creates a ds_tree of key-value pairs from static arrays of keys and values.

methods.name: get_pair
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a string pair for insertion into a ds_tree.

methods.name: free_str_pair
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a string pair.

methods.name: free_str_tree
methods.description: Frees a ds_tree of string key-value pairs.

methods.name: schema2int_set
methods.description: Converts a static array of integers into a dynamically allocated int set.

methods.name: free_int_set
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for an int set.

methods.name: schema2itree
methods.description: Creates a ds_tree of string key and int value pairs from static arrays.

methods.name: free_str_ipair
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a string-int pair.

methods.name: free_str_itree
methods.description: Frees a ds_tree of string key and int value pairs.
